emulation.label: Samsung dimensions on stock Android — layout emulation

sources.purpose: Samsung launch specifications: inner/cover resolutions, physical dimensions and pixel densities; published 2026-07-22.
Independent Samsung product comparison confirms Fold8 1848×2448 and Fold8 Ultra 2256×2504 panels.
Samsung confirms emulator skins run stock Android and do not reproduce One UI.
Native foldable engine selection, physical hinge sensor and fold/unfold commands. SupportPixelFold is an internal emulator engine flag, not the emulated product identity.
The dual-panel engine creates the cover panel from hw.displayRegion.0.1 and uses hw.lcd.density on both panels.
prepareSkinConfig loads per-device guest XML from system-image/data/misc/<hw.device.name> on fresh userdata creation.
AOSP emulator display-address and guest XML schema reference only; no Pixel screen size, device profile, cutout or OEM layout is copied.
Native WindowManager state-to-posture mapping; CLOSED maps to no folding features, HALF_OPENED to half-open, OPENED to flat.
Native runtime resource overlays and system-partition overlay configuration.
The generated preinstalled system RRO uses Android's legacy targetSdk28 device-overlay policy; it is confined to the disposable QA emulator.

assumptions: 420 logical dpi is a chosen stock-Android test density on both panels. Samsung publishes physical ppi, not the verified default Android logical density. These are different quantities.
The continuous inner display has an ideal zero-width vertical fold at its midpoint in book orientation. Exact Samsung fold bounds and angle thresholds have not been measured on hardware.

The native emulator uses closed 0–30 degrees, half-open 30–150 degrees, and open 150–180 degrees, with capture targets 0/90/180 degrees. These thresholds are test configuration, not verified Samsung firmware behavior.

The captures use stock Android system bars and rectangular display geometry. Samsung One UI taskbars, display zoom defaults, camera holes, rounded-corner masks and Flex Mode policy are not reproduced.

The native framework overlay configures static per-device geometry and the sensor-driven state map. No Dart geometry, wm-size override, simulated app display features or per-capture posture-setting override is used.
Product specifications list Android 17/One UI 9; this layout workflow uses the installed stock Android API 36 image and does not claim OS-version parity.

galaxy-z-fold8.specificationNote: Use the 1848-pixel short edge in Samsung's launch specifications and product comparison. Samsung's skin catalogue instead says 1828; no skin archive is used. Unfolded physical dimensions 161.4×123.9 mm establish the landscape book orientation.
